summary: Complete **self-service RGPD** flow: server `GET /me/export` (incl. own documents metadata, notes, guardians if minor), hardened `PATCH /me` consent rules, setup gate after login; webapp screens setup inicial, perfil y descàrrega «Les meues dades». **Server + web (wasmJs)**.
overview:
Completes what `platform-server-auth` leaves open (RGPD export, consent hardening, full self-profile editing) and connects it to the web management shell.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §5.4, §6.7 (`/me/export`), §7.3 · `docs/decisiones.md` (RGPD).

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-server-infra`, `platform-schema-v02`, `platform-core-contract`
- `platform-server-auth`: Bearer session, `GET/PATCH /me`, `ConsentRequiredPlugin` (allowlist already includes `/me/export`)
- `platform-web-shell`: GIS login, `SessionManager`, `AuthViewModel`, `AppNavigation`

**Behaviour summary (`decisiones.md`)**
1. After login, if `consent.dataProcessing == false`, webapp navigates to **setup** (`/configuracio-inicial`) until the user (or tutor text in `signedBy` for minors) accepts privacy policy via `PATCH /me`.
2. Any API call returning `403 consent_required` redirects the webapp to `/configuracio-inicial`.
3. `GET /me` and `GET /me/export` return self-visible data including `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `notes`, and (when minor) `guardians`. `GET /me/export` additionally bundles `orgRoles`, `positions`, own `attendance`, active `sessions` (no hashes), and metadata of `documents` linked to `userId = me` (e.g., signed consent PDFs).
4. Profile screen edits only §5.4 self fields (using `PatchField<T>` + `version`) and provides a download button saving `muixeranga-dades-YYYY-MM-DD.json` via browser `Blob` download.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` green.
- Integration: `GET /api/v1/me/export` → `200 application/json` containing `user` (with `notes`, `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `guardians` if minor), `orgRoles`, `positions`, `attendance`, `documents` (own `userId` only), `sessions`; never `googleSub` or refresh hashes; accessible even before `dataProcessing=true`.
- `PATCH /me` enforces monotonic `dataProcessing` (`false -> true` only; `true -> false` returns `422 validation_failed`), server fills `signedAt = now()` if omitted when enabling `dataProcessing` or changing consents, and requires non-blank `signedBy` when enabling `dataProcessing`.
- Web: login without consent → forced setup → after accept `AuthViewModel` refreshes `Me` and enters app; menu «Les meues dades» downloads JSON file.
shared_ui_policy: All screens, ViewModels, repositories, and browser download `expect/actual` live in `:app:shared` (`commonMain` + `wasmJsMain`). `:app:webApp` only mounts the shell. Android/desktop/JS targets out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- Admin user CRUD and `POST /users/{id}/anonymize` (`spec-05-members`).
- `PUT/DELETE /me/avatar` upload UI/routes (`platform-files`).
- Sessions management UI (owned by `platform-web-shell`).
- Public `/public/members` filtering (`spec-05-members`).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`; setup and export require logged-in user.
auth.server: Bearer JWT; `GET /me`, `PATCH /me`, and `GET /me/export` are on `ConsentRequiredPlugin` allowlist.

components.name: MeExportResponse
components.usage: Stable RGPD export JSON envelope (`exportedAt`, `formatVersion`, `user: UserSelf`, `positions`, `attendance`, `documents`, `sessions`) — avoids duplicating `account`/`orgRoles` already inside `UserSelf`.

components.name: MeExportService
components.usage: Aggregate `UserSelf` (incl. `notes`, `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `guardians` if minor, `account`, `orgRoles`), own `positions`, own `attendance`, own `documents` metadata (`id`, `title`, `kind`, `date`, `file`, `createdAt`), and own `sessions` summaries.
components.notes: Never exposes `google_identities`, `refresh_tokens`, or other users' data.

components.name: ConsentRules
components.usage: Harden `PATCH /me`: `dataProcessing` monotonic (`false -> true` only), require `signedBy` when enabling `dataProcessing`, auto-stamp `signedAt = Clock.System.now()` if omitted on consent change, reject `dataProcessing = false` once `true` with `422`.

components.name: BrowserFileDownload (expect/actual)
components.usage: `expect fun downloadBytes(filename: String, mimeType: String, bytes: ByteArray)` with `wasmJsMain` actual creating a `Blob` + temporary `<a download>` click, and minimal no-op actuals in other targets so multiplatform compilation stays green.
components.notes: Reused by calendar export (`spec-03-calendar`) and document download (`spec-08-documents`).

components.name: ProfileRepository
components.usage: Wraps `MuixerangaApi.getMe()`, `patchMe()`, `exportMe()` and updates shared `SessionManager` / `AuthViewModel` Me state after consent or profile save.

components.name: ProfileViewModel
components.usage: Exposes `StateFlow<ProfileUiState>` handling Setup, Profile edit (client-side `:core` validation + `409 version_conflict` reload prompt), and JSON export download.

components.name: ConsentSetupScreen
components.usage: Blocking first-run screen at `/configuracio-inicial`: privacy policy link (`https://muixerangadelx.com/privacitat`, configurable via `PRIVACY_POLICY_URL`), mandatory `dataProcessing` checkbox, `signedBy` text field (prefilled with full name, tutor guidance if `isMinor`), optional toggles for `publicProfile`/`imageRights`/`whatsapp`.

components.name: ProfileScreen
components.usage: Route `/el-meu-perfil` matching mockup: navy `#14005E` hero banner (red avatar circle, full name, `«nickname»`, role/area badges, outlined `Canvia la foto` hook for `platform-files`), 2-column layout with left editable cards (`Informació personal` incl. `preferredLocale` «Idioma de la interfície», `Contacte i emergència`, `Privacitat i dades` switches + «Descarrega les meues dades» JSON callout + `DESA` CTA) and right warm-grey card with yellow `#FFC432` top stripe (`Informació de només lectura`: Nom, Cognoms, Data de naixement/edat, Estat, Tipus de membre, Càrrecs actuals, plus `notes` and `guardians` when present/minor).

components.name: AppNavigation consent gate
components.usage: Connect `/configuracio-inicial` and `/el-meu-perfil` to real screens, redirect automatically when `!me.consent.dataProcessing` or on global `403 consent_required` event from `SessionManager`.

structure:
End-to-end RGPD flow:

```text
Login (platform-web-shell)
  → AuthViewModel loads GET /api/v1/me
  → if !me.consent.dataProcessing → redirect /configuracio-inicial (ConsentSetupScreen)
  → user accepts → PATCH /api/v1/me → AuthViewModel refreshes Me → navigate home

ProfileScreen (/el-meu-perfil)
  → Save → validate (:core) → PATCH /api/v1/me (with version & PatchField)
  → Export → GET /api/v1/me/export → BrowserFileDownload.downloadBytes(...)
```

`MeExportResponse` JSON structure (`formatVersion = 1`):
- `exportedAt`: UTC `Instant`
- `formatVersion`: `1`
- `user`: `UserSelf` (includes `consent`, `account` self-safe, `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `guardians` if minor, `notes`, `orgRoles`)
- `positions`: list of `UserPositionSummary` for this user
- `attendance`: list of own `Attendance` rows
- `documents`: list of own `Document` metadata (`id`, `title`, `kind`, `date`, `file`, `notes`, `createdAt`) where `user_id = me`
- `sessions`: list of `SessionSummary` (no token hashes)

sections.title: Consent setup rules (server + web)
sections.description: Screen title «Configuració inicial». Displays a link to the privacy policy (`https://muixerangadelx.com/privacitat`, overridable via compile-time config), a mandatory checkbox for `consent.dataProcessing`, and a `signedBy` input (defaulting to the user's name; for minors, copy explicitly states that a legal guardian must sign and enter their name).
sections.behavior: Submit is disabled until `dataProcessing` is checked and `signedBy` is non-blank. On `PATCH /me`, the server rejects setting `dataProcessing` from `true` back to `false` (`422 validation_failed`), requires `signedBy` when transitioning `false -> true`, and stamps `signedAt` server-side with current UTC `Instant` whenever consent flags change if the client omitted it. On success, `ProfileRepository` notifies `AuthViewModel` so the consent gate unlocks immediately.

sections.title: Minor visibility consistency (`decisiones.md`)
sections.description: Both `GET /me` and `GET /me/export` follow the exact same self-visibility rule: the authenticated user sees `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `notes`, and (when `isMinor == true`) their `guardians` list.
sections.behavior: Neither `GET /me` nor `GET /me/export` exposes board-only fields (`documentId`, `memberNumber`, `leftAt`, `birthDate`) or server-only tables (`google_identities`, `refresh_tokens`).

sections.title: Profile editing and download (`ProfileScreen`)
sections.description: «El meu perfil» renders the navy hero banner (avatar, name, nickname, badges, «Canvia la foto» wired once `platform-files` lands) above a 2-column layout (stacked on mobile): left column has 3 bordered white cards — `Informació personal` (malnom, telèfon, carrer i número, codi postal, ciutat, sobre mi, talla de camiseta, talla de pantaló, **idioma de la interfície** `preferredLocale`), `Contacte i emergència`, and `Privacitat i dades` (switches `Perfil públic a la web`, `Drets d'imatge`, `Grup de WhatsApp` + callout box «Descarrega les meues dades») with red `DESA` button; right column shows the yellow-top-bordered `Informació de només lectura` card («Per a canviar-ho, parla amb la junta»: Nom, Cognoms, Data de naixement, Estat, Tipus de membre, Càrrecs actuals, plus `notes` and `guardians` if minor).
sections.behavior: Sends only changed fields (including `preferredLocale`) via `PatchField<T>` + `version`. On `409 version_conflict`, shows «Algú ha modificat aquest element mentre l'editaves» with a «Recarrega» action. Clicking «Descarrega les meues dades» calls `GET /api/v1/me/export` and downloads `muixeranga-dades-YYYY-MM-DD.json` via `BrowserFileDownload`.
